title: Galarian Moltres 083/132 Pokemon S-Chinese Nine Colors Gathering (Friends) cs4aC
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This Galarian Moltres card from the Nine Colors Gathering set is a must-have for any Pokémon TCG collector. The holo rare finish and ancient creature/monster type make it a unique addition to your collection. The card is made of high-quality card stock and features the characters of Galarian Moltres in simplified Chinese language. 

It is a standard size card and has the card number 083/132. The card is a basic stage and has no speciality or autographed features. This card is perfect for players aged 4 and above and is an excellent way to add to your Pokémon TCG collection.
